corrections.verdict: verified for the flags; the two-flag form needs a new reader
corrections.reason: FLAG(6,7) is set only on Bob's later talk with a party total under 30 (it is what makes Paildramon appear, wstag450 actor6). FLAG_DRI_BOB_TALKED is set on the very first talk at any party level, which is what the step says. There is a second way to Veemon that never meets Bob: in the extra chapter Piledrimon (wstag970) gives the DDNA and unlocks Veemon, with FLAG_PILEDRIMON_FOUGHT set as the battle starts. On that way, step 1 stays false with any Bob flag while step 3 reads true, and QuestProgressHelper.isStarterOwnedPattern reports the quest as unavailable, as if Veemon came in the starter pack. Veemon is in no starter pack (party.c STARTER_PARTIES), so that reading is always wrong for this quest. Hence anyOf; or keep the single Bob flag and stop applying the pattern to Veemon.

resetByWstag385.reason: wstag385 clears only 0x1A,0x37-0x3B (and sets item 0x12). The Etemon flags 0x1A,0x3C-0x40 and FLAG_KING_ETEMON_* are separate bits. wstag386 has its own reset: KingEtemon's first win clears 0x1A,0x3C-0x40, the same way.

notes: Trophy steps 1-5 carry orItem because of wstag386's reset: without it the finished quest would read as unavailable, the same fault as asukaTrophy.
The rematch reads the same five flags as the trophy, which is why it needs the trophy as requisite, as the Asuka pair does.
Folder Bag (item 0x192) is needed to get past: two Etemon (wstag386 actors 21, 22) stand in the way until the player has it.
The fourth Etemon only needs the Mike in the first run: with the trophy held, actor 12 replaces actor 11 and asks for nothing.
Texts follow the Asuka quests. The game calls all four Etemon by the same name, so first to fourth is the app's wording; the order is the walking order from the arrival point, not a rule of the game.
